x-m-h2-01.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
x-m-h2-01.goal: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.
x-m-h2-01.material: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca kwisisombululo sikaMinho onengxaki. (Ukuba imigca emininzi elandelanayo inengxaki, usenokukhetha omnye kuphela kuyo.)
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amaxabiso asekupheleni kwesisombululo ngqo kulingano lomgca wokuqala. Kwenzeka ntoni kwixabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm?
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.explain: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.prompt: Xelela uMinho isisombululo esichanekileyo nesizathu. Bandakanya ingxaki eyenzekayo xa ufaka u-x=−1 kulingano lokuqala.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funda ukhangela isizathu sokuba ugama liguqulwe kumgca ngamnye.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-x=−1 no-x=5 ngamnye emaxabisweni angaphakathi eelogarithm kulingano lokuqala, ukhangele ukuba amaxabiso aba yintoni.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze ukuba kutheni u-x=−1 engenakuba sisisombululo usebenzisa ixabiso elingaphakathi?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe yeyiphi imeko eyayifuneka ngaphambi kokuba ugama liguqulwe?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ufake u-x=5 kulingano lokuqala ukhangela ukuba lunelisa?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.0: Isisombululo esiyodwa ngu-x=5. Ukuba ndifaka u-x=−1, ixabiso elingaphakathi linegethivu njenge-log₂(−2), ngoko alichaziwe. Ngoko u-5 kuphela, owanelisa imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi x>3, sisisombululo.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.1: Xa kusonjululwa ulingano, amaxabiso angaphakathi kufuneka ahlale epositivu. x−1>0 no-x−3>0, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka, kwaye x=−1 ayikho kolu luhlu, ngoko kufuneka ilahlwe. Ngoko impendulo ngu-x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.2: Ukusuka kwiimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0, x>3. x=−1 ingaphandle koluhlu, ngoko yilahle, kwaye impendulo ngu-5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.3: Impendulo ngu-5. Ukufaka u-x=−1 kunika i-log₂(−2), engachazwanga, ngoko asisisombululo.

x-m-h2-04.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
x-m-h2-04.goal: Vavanya ukuqhelekisa 'zihlala zimbini' ngamaxabiso athile uze uchaze ngezizathu ukuba zeziphi iimeko apho kungabambi.
x-m-h2-04.material: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
x-m-h2-04.prereq.0: Imilinganiselo ye-trigonometry nonxulumano phakathi kwamacala nee-engile konxantathu
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.prompt: Yenza onxantathu abahambelana neemeko xa b=8. Fumana ubude c obuyi-2 obahlukileyo obunokwenzeka becala AB.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ubhale ulingano lwe-c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha zonke izisombululo zolo lingano ezinokusetyenziswa njengobude becala.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Ubude becala kufuneka bube bukhulu kune-0.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Ulingano olufunyenwe ngokufaka a=7, b=8 kumthetho wekhosayini a²=b²+c²−2bc·cos60° alubambi.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.explain: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha onke amaxabiso e-b anokusetyenziswa ukuphikisa ingxelo kaGaeun (ukuba b inkulu kune-7, bahlala bekho onxantathu ababini). Kwi-b nganye, misela ulingano lwe-c ngendlela efanayo.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kwi-b nganye, lungisa i-49=b²+c²−bc njengequadratiki kwi-c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola nge-discriminant ukuba ulingano olulungisiweyo lunengcambu zeneneni na, uze uhlole nokuba ixabiso lingaphakathi komda b>7.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.a: Iba yi-c²−10c+51=0, engenangcambu zeneneni. Le yimeko apho akukho nxantathu unokwenziwa nakanye.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.b: b=5 iphandle komda othi 'b inkulu kune-7', ngoko ayiphikisi ingxelo kaGaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.c: b=8 yimeko apho onxantathu ababini benziwa, ngoko ixhasa ingxelo kaGaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.d: Iba yi-c²−12c+95=0, engenangcambu zeneneni. Akukho nxantathu unokwenziwa nakanye.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.e: b=7 ayibandakanywa kumda othi 'inkulu kune-7'. Yimeko engenanto yakwenza nengxelo kaGaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.f: Iba yi-c²−9c+32=0, engenangcambu zeneneni. Akukho nxantathu unokwenziwa.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.explain: Ngomthetho wekhosayini, 49=b²+c²−bc, oko kukuthi c²−bc+(b²−49)=0. Ukuze kuvele izisombululo ezimbini ezahlukileyo ezipozithivu, i-discriminant 196−3b² kufuneka ibe pozithivu kwaye b>7, ngoko b kufuneka ibe ncinci kune-8.08 malunga. Kwi-b=9, 10, 12 azikho iingcambu zeneneni, ngoko akukho nxantathu unokwenziwa nakanye. b=5 no-7 ziphandle komda b>7.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.prompt: Phendula uGaeun kwisivakalisi esi-1 okanye ezi-2. Chaza ngemizekelo ukuba zingaphi onxantathu abenziwayo ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso le-b.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Thelekisa isiphumo se-b=8 osifumeneyo ngentla neziphumo zamanye amaxabiso e-b (umzekelo 9, 10).
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Misela ulingano lwe-c ngendlela efanayo ubale ukuba mangaphi amaxabiso apozithivu afanelekileyo e-c akhoyo.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlole, ngolingano lwe-c, ukuba zingaphi onxantathu kwixabiso le-b olinikileyo?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ukhankanye zombini imeko enonxantathu ababini neyo engenanto?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uchaze, nokuba ngokumalunga, ukuba kutheni onxantathu bayeka ukwenziwa xa b iba nkulu?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.model.0: Hayi ngamaxesha onke. Ukuba b=8, c=3 no-5, ngoko zikho ezimbini, kodwa ukuba b=10, ulingano lwe-c alunasisombululo, ngoko akukho nxantathu wenziwayo.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.model.1: Hayi. Ukuba b iba nkulu kakhulu, akukho nxantathu wenziwayo. Ukuba b ngu-9 okanye 10, ulingano lwequadratiki lwe-c alunangcambu zeneneni, ngoko alusebenzi. Zimbini kuphela xa b inkulu kancinci kune-7, njenge-b=8.

x-m-h2-06.title: Hlola isisombululo esifumene ilungu jikelele ukusuka kwisixa solandelelwano
x-m-h2-06.goal: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki kwisisombululo esifumana ilungu jikelele ukusuka kwisixa Sₙ solandelelwano, uze ufumane ngokwakho imeko apho lingabhalwa njengefomula e-1.
x-m-h2-06.material: Esi sisisombululo sikaSeoa sokufumana ilungu jikelele xa isixa Sₙ samagama okuqala n olandelelwano {aₙ} yi-Sₙ = n² + 2n + 1. (Funda Sₙ njenge-'S sub n', aₙ njenge-'a sub n', kunye ne-Sₙ₋₁ njenge-'S sub n minus 1'.)
x-m-h2-06.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yesixa Sₙ nelungu jikelele aₙ lolandelelwano
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca kwisisombululo sikaSeoa onengxaki. (Ukuba imigca emininzi elandelelanayo inengxaki, unokukhetha omnye wayo kuphela.)
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ukuba imeko (uluhlu lwe-n) ekuqaleni komgca ngamnye ifana noluhlu kwisigqibo sokugqibela na.
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana ilungu lokuqala a₁ ngqo kwinkcazo ye-Sₙ, uze uyithelekise nexabiso emgceni wesi-5.
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko kuwo onke amanani endalo n, aₙ = 2n + 1
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-4 uyingxaki. Umgca woku-1 wathi n≥2, ngoko aₙ=2n+1 yifomula efunyenwe kuphela kwi-n≥2. Ilungu lokuqala kufuneka lifunyanwe ngokwahlukileyo: a₁=S₁=1+2+1=4, eyahlukileyo kwi-2·1+1=3. Ngoko a₁=3 emgceni wesi-5 iphosakele nayo.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ilungu jikelele elichanekileyo uze uchaze ukuba uSeoa wasilela ntoni.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ifomula yokufumana a₁ ichazwa ngokwahlukileyo kwi-aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. Khumbula intsingiselo yelungu lokuqala.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ixabiso le-2n+1 kwi-n=1 nexabiso le-S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ufumene a₁ kwi-S₁ kunokuba ufumane kwi-aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe kufuneka uhlole ukuba ifomula efunyenwe kwi-n≥2 isebenza nakwi-n=1?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ulibhale ilungu jikelele ngeemeko ezimbini kunokuba lifomula e-1?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.model.0: a₁=S₁=4, kwaye kwi-n≥2, aₙ=2n+1. USeoa akazange ahlole ukuba ifomula efunyenwe kwi-n≥2 isebenza nakwi-n=1. Ukufaka n=1 kunika i-3, eyahlukileyo kwi-a₁=4.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.model.1: Ilungu jikelele kufuneka libhalwe ngeenxalenye ezi-2: a₁=4, kwaye aₙ=2n+1 (n≥2). S₁=4, kodwa ukufaka n=1 kwi-2n+1 kunika i-3, ngoko abalingani. Ilungu lokuqala kufuneka lifunyanwe ngokwahlukileyo.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-Sₙ = p·n² + q·n + r (p, q, r zizinani eliphelele, p≠0), fumana (p, q, r) ezintathu ezahlukileyo apho ixabiso elifunyenwe ngokufaka n=1 kwifomula efunyenwe kwi-n≥2 lilingana no-a₁, ukuze ilungu jikelele lingabhalwa njengefomula e-1.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kwi-Sₙ=pn²+qn+r, bhala Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁ kwi-n≥2 ngokwe-p ne-q.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ixabiso olifumana ngokufaka n=1 kuloo fomula ne-S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c1: p, q, r zizinani eliphelele kwaye p akufuneki ibe ngu-0.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.ok.c2: Ixabiso lefomula efunyenwe kwi-n≥2 kwi-n=1 lilingana no-a₁=S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Ixabiso p+q lefomula p(2n−1)+q efunyenwe kwi-n≥2 kwi-n=1 alilingani ne-S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.explain: Kwi-n≥2, aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁=p(2n−1)+q, ngoko ukufaka n=1 kunika i-p+q. a₁=S₁=p+q+r, ngoko zilingana kuphela xa r=0. Sₙ=n²+2n+1 inayo r=1, ngoko ilungu lokuqala belifanele liphathwe ngokwahlukileyo.

x-m-h2-07.title: Ingaba ∞−∞ ilingana no-0? Ukuhlola amabango abahlobo ababini
x-m-h2-07.goal: Vavanya amabango amabini ngobalo lwamanani, chaza apho ingqiqo yokucinga yaphosakala khona, uze emva koko ufumane umda usebenzisa i-algebra.
x-m-h2-07.material: UMinsu wathi, 'Njengoko x iba nkulu ngokungapheliyo, √(x²+x) isondela kwi-x, ngoko √(x²+x) − x isondela kwi-0.' USeoa wathi, 'Ayisondeli kwi-0, isondela kunani elithile lepozithivu.' Indlela yokufunda: √(x²+x) yingcambu ye-x isikwere kunye no-x, kwaye 'x iba nkulu ngokungapheliyo' yi-x→∞.
x-m-h2-07.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yomda xa x iba nkulu ngokungapheliyo
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.prompt: Unokusebenzisa ikhalkyuleyitha. Khetha amanani apheleleyo amathathu x angama-100 ubuncinane, ubale ixabiso le-√(x²+x) − x, ulijikelezise kwiindawo ezintathu zedesimali, uze ulifake njenge-(x, ixabiso). Ukufaka x ezintathu ezahlukileyo kuyagqiba. (Ukuba ibango likaMinsu lilunge, eli xabiso kufuneka lisondele kwi-0 okukhona x inkulu.)
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza x ibe nkulu ngakumbi ubone ukuba ixabiso lihamba kweliphi icala.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c1: x linani eliphelele eli-100 okanye ngaphezulu.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c1: x kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele eli-100 okanye ngaphezulu.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c2: Ixabiso olingenisileyo lihambelana nesiphumo esibaliweyo se-√(x²+x)−x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c2: Ixabiso olingenisileyo lahlukile kwisiphumo esibaliweyo. Bala kwakhona i-√(x²+x)−x ngekhaltyuleyitha uyijikelezele kwiindawo ezintathu zedesimali.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.explain: Kwa-x=100 imalunga ne-0.4988, kwa-x=1000 malunga ne-0.49988, kwaye kwa-x=10000 malunga ne-0.49999. Nokuba wenza x ibe nkulu, ayisondeli kwi-0 kodwa ihlala kufuphi ne-0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.prompt: Ujonga iziphumo ezibaliweyo, sesiphi isibakala sika-Minsu okanye sika-Seoa esixhaswe ngcono? Khetha eyona nkcazelo ifanelekileyo.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Beka macala ngamacala amaxabiso abaliweyo kumaxabiso amathathu e-x uze ubone ukuba ixabiso litshintsha njani xa x ikhula.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.a: Isibakala sika-Seoa sixhasiwe. Umahluko uqokelelana ejikeleze ixabiso elingengo-0
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.a: Nokuba x yenziwe yaba nkulu, ixabiso alizange litshintshe kufuphi ne-0.5, ngoko bubungqina obuchasene nesibakala sokuba li-0.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.b: UMinsu unyanisile. Umlinganiselo uyasondela kwi-1, ngoko umahluko uyasondela kwi-0 nawo
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.b: Umlinganiselo osondela kwi-1 awuthethi ukuba umahluko usondela kwi-0. Umzekelo, umlinganiselo we-x ne-x+0.5 uyasondela kwi-1, kodwa umahluko uhlala ungu-0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.c: UMinsu unyanisile. Ixabiso elinkulu kune-0 yimpazamo yekhaltyuleyitha
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.c: Xa utshintsha x kwaye amaxabiso eqokelelana ejikeleze ixabiso elifanayo (kufuphi ne-0.5), kunzima ukulibiza impazamo.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.d: Akunakuxelwa nangayiphi indlela. Ukubala akunakukuxelela nto
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.d: Amanani akangqini umda, kodwa bubungqina obuchasene nesibakala se-'0'.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.explain: Amaxabiso abaliweyo aqokelelana kufuphi ne-0.5 nokuba x ikhula, ngoko isibakala sika-Seoa sixhasiwe. Kodwa amanani bubungqina nje kuphela, kwaye ukuhlola ngokuchanekileyo ukuba ixabiso yintoni, kufuneka uguqule ikhweshini.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuba kutheni ingqiqo ka-Minsu '√(x²+x) iyasondela kwi-x, ngoko umahluko ngu-0' iphosisile, uze ufumane ixabiso lomda ngokuguqula ikhweshini.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba inani elingasentla liba yintoni xa uphindaphinda uze wahlule √(x²+x)−x nge-√(x²+x)+x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yahlula inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi nge-x, emva koko ubone ukuba lilipi ixabiso icandelo ngalinye elisondela kulo xa x ikhula ngaphandle komda.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba wahlule ukuba amaxabiso amabini asondelayo kunye nomahluko wamaxabiso amabini uya kwi-0?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba utshintsho owenzileyo luguqule ikhweshini yaba yifom apho umda unokufunyanwa khona?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ixabiso olibonileyo ngokubala (0.4999…) nomda owufumeneyo ziyahambelana?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.0: Ukusondela kwi-x kuthetha ukuba umlinganiselo usondela kwi-1, hayi ukuba umahluko uba ngu-0. Ukwenza inani elingasentla libe nengqiqo kunika x/(√(x²+x)+x)=1/(√(1+1/x)+1), kwaye njengoko x→∞ yi-1/2.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.1: Nokuba √(x²+x) ibonakala ifana ne-x, kusekho umahluko phakathi kwamanani amabini, ngoko akufuneki ndiyitshintshe ibe yi-x−x=0. Ukuphindaphinda inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi ngokudityanisiweyo √(x²+x)+x kunika x/(√(x²+x)+x), kwaye umda yi-0.5 (=1/2).

x-m-h2-08.title: Ukusuka kwisantya esiphakathi ukuya kwisantya sokukhawuleza
x-m-h2-08.goal: Nciphisa isithuba, ubone ukuba isantya esiphakathi sisondela kwixabiso elithini, uze uququzelele intsingiselo yesantya sokukhawuleza ngokwakho.

Kodwa isantya yi-(umgama ohanjiweyo)÷(ixesha elithathiweyo), kwaye 'kwangoko' ixesha elithathiweyo li-0, ngoko kubonakala ngathi awukwazi ukwahlula.

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba uqikelelo lwakho kunye nexabiso elitsha liyavumelana, kwaye ukuba akunjalo, cinga ukuba uphosise ntoni.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Isantya esiphakathi kwisithuba [1, 3] imizuzwana yi-(9−1)÷2 = 4 m/s.

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ukuba isantya siyatshintsha ngaphakathi kwesithuba, awukwazi ukuthi isantya esiphakathi silingana nesantya kwixesha lokuqala.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Andikwazi ukuthi okwangoku. Kufuneka ndifumane isantya esiphakathi kwiziithuba ezimfutshane ezisuka kwi-1 umzuzwana nazo
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Endaweni yokuqinisekisa ixesha elinye ngomndilili omnye kwisithuba eside, uzama ukuhlola ngezithuba ezincinci.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Andikwazi ukwazi. Kwangoko ixesha li-0, ngoko isantya asinakuchazwa
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Awukwazi ukwahlula kwangoko kwisithuba sexesha eli-0, kodwa kukho indlela yokusondela ngezithuba ezimfutshane.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Isantya esiphakathi kwisithuba [1, 2] yi-3, kwi-[1, 1.5] yi-(2.25−1)÷0.5 = 2.5, kwaye kwi-[1, 1.1] yi-(1.21−1)÷0.1 = 2.1 m/s.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ukuba unciphisa isithuba ngakumbi, njenge-[1, 1.01], [1, 1.001], kwenzeka ntoni kwisantya esiphakathi?
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.after: [1, 1.01] inika (1.0201−1)÷0.01 = 2.01, kwaye [1, 1.001] inika i-2.001. Zombini inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi ziyasondela kwi-0, kodwa umlinganiselo uqokelelana ukuya kwi-2.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Iyasondela kwi-0. Kuba ubude besithuba buyasondela kwi-0

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uqikelele ixabiso eliqokelelana ejikeleze lona ukusuka kumkhwa wokwehla kwesantya esiphakathi: 3, 2.5, 2.1.

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Endaweni yokufaka h=0, uthathe njengesantya sokukhawuleza indawo apho ixabiso lisondela khona ngelixa h isondela kwi-0.

x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba le parabola kufuneka idibane njani ne-eksisi ye-x ukuze f'(c)=0 kodwa uphawu lwe-f' lungatshintshi.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.ok.c2: f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b iyachukumisa i-eksisi ye-x. Kukho c ene-f'(c)=0, kodwa uphawu lwe-f' alutshintshi.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.fail.c2: Idiskriminanti 4a²−12b ye-f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ayingo-0. Ukuba inkulu kune-0, uphawu lwe-f' luyatshintsha kwaye i-extremum iyavela, kwaye ukuba incinci kune-0, akukho c ene-f'(c)=0.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.explain: Ukuba f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b iyachukumisa i-eksisi ye-x (idiskriminanti 4a²−12b=0, oko kukuthi, a²=3b), ngoko f'(x)=3(x+a/3)²≥0, ngoko nangona kukho indawo apho f'=0, f iqhubeka ikhula. Umzekelo, ukuba a=0, b=0, ngoko f(x)=x³ kwaye f'(0)=0 kodwa akukho extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: Kwimisebenzi oyenzileyo ngentla, f'(c)=0 kodwa kwakungekho extremum. Yeyiphi eyona meko ifanelekileyo yokuba ne-extremum?
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga uphawu lwe-f'(x) kumsebenzi owenzileyo kwinyathelo elidlulileyo, ekhohlo nasekunene ka-c.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa intsingiselo ye-extremum (itshintsha ukusuka kokonyuka ukuya kokuhla, njalonjalo) nenketho nganye.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.a: f'(c)=0 kwaye uphawu lwe-f' lutshintsha macala omabini ka-c
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.a: Ukhomba ukuba ngaphezu kwe-f'(c)=0, imeko yokuba ukonyuka nokuhla kutshintshisana iyafuneka.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.b: Ukuba nje f'(c)=0, ihlala iyi-extremum nokuba uphawu lunjani
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.b: Kumzekelo owenze ngaphambili (f(x)=x³ njalonjalo), f'(0)=0 kodwa kwakungekho extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.c: f'(c)=0 kwaye ixabiso lomsebenzi f(c) kufuneka libe ngu-0 nalo
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.c: Ixabiso le-f(c) alinanto yakwenza nokuba i-extremum ikho na. Kwa-f(x)=x³+1, f'(0)=0 kwaye f(0)=1, kodwa akukho extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.d: Ukuba f'(c)>0, ithambeka lomgca othintelayo kuloo ndawo libonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko umsebenzi uyakhula. Alingomgqugqisi we-extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.explain: Ukuze c ibe yi-extremum, f'(c)=0 kwaye uphawu lwe-f' kufuneka lutshintshe macala omabini ka-c (ukonyuka↔ukuhla). f'(c)=0 yimeko efunekayo kuphela yokuba umgqugqisi abe yi-extremum.

x-m-h2-02.title: Ngaba amandla ka-2 ahlala enkulu kuno-x isikwere?
x-m-h2-02.goal: Fumana umzekelo ochasayo webango lokuba 2ˣ>x² ihlala ibamba, uze ugwebe ukuba kutheni unokuthi liqala phi ixabiso ukubamba.
x-m-h2-02.material: USeojin wabona ukuba xa x=1, 2¹=2>1², nalapho x=5, 2⁵=32>5²=25, wathi, ‘Kunani elipheleleyo x elipositivu, 2ˣ ihlala inkulu kuno-x².’ (2ˣ linani olifumana ngokuphindaphinda u-2 ngokwakhe ixesha ngexesha x, kwaye x² linani olifumana ngokuphindaphinda u-x kabini.)
x-m-h2-02.thinking.1: Wahlula ukukhangela iimeko ezithile nokuchaza isizathu
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.prompt: Fumana amanani amabini aphelele apositivu ahlukeneyo x abonisa ukuba ibango likaSeojin liphosakele. (Oko kukuthi x apho 2ˣ ingenkulu kuno-x², oko kukuthi 2ˣ ≤ x².)
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka x=1, 2, 3, ... ngokulandelelana, ubhale amaxabiso e-2ˣ ne-x² macala.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga amaxabiso aphakathi kwe-x=1 ne-x=5 awakhangelwa nguSeojin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c1: x kufuneka libe linani elipheleleyo elilingana okanye elikhulu kuno-1.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Kule x, 2ˣ inkulu kuno-x². Alilo ixabiso elophula ibango likaSeojin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba x=2, ngoko 2²=4=2²; ukuba x=3, ngoko 2³=8<9=3²; ukuba x=4, ngoko 2⁴=16=4². Ezi ntathu ngemizekelo echasayo. Kwi-x=1 okanye x=5, 2ˣ inkulu ngakumbi.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku ufuna ukuthi, ‘Kunani elipheleleyo lilonke x elilingana okanye elikhulu kuno-5, 2ˣ>x².’ Sesiphi esona sizathu sifanelekileyo sokuba oku kuhlala kubamba?
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Wahlula ukuba ukhetho ngalunye lithi ‘kutheni kunjalo kuyo yonke x’ okanye lithi kuphela ‘mingaphi imeko ekhangelweyo’.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala kwitheyibhile ukuba lingakanani ixesha amaxabiso omabini aba makhulu ngalo xa uhamba usuka kwi-x=5 ukuya kwi-6 nakwi-7.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.a: Ndibale ngalinye ukusuka kwi-x=5 ukuya kwi-x=20 ndafumana 2ˣ>x² rhoqo ngaphandle kokuhlukile
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.a: Nokuba ukhangela iimeko ezingama-20, awunakwazi ukuba ixabiso elilandelayo liyabamba. Ukukhangela iimeko ezithile bubungqina, asisosizathu.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.b: Xa x inyuka nge-1, 2ˣ iphindwa kabini, yaye x² ikhula ngaphantsi kokuphindwa kabini (kwi-x≥3)
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.b: Oku kuthelekisa ukuba lingakanani ixabiso ngalinye kula mabini likhula kwinyathelo ngalinye, kwaye kufumana isizathu sokuba umsantsa uqhubeke uphakama.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.c: 2ˣ yimisebenzi yokukhula ngezikhuphi kwaye x² yimisebenzi ye-polynomial, ngoko 2ˣ inkulu ukusuka kwi-5
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.c: Kuyinyani ukuba umsebenzi wokukhula ngezikhuphi ekugqibeleni uba mkhulu, kodwa kwakungekho njalo ukususela ekuqaleni, njengakwi-x=3. Oku akuchazi ukuba liqala phi.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.d: Ukuba uzoba iigrafu, igrafu ye-2ˣ iphezu kwegrafu ye-x²
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.d: Igrafu iyanceda ekuqikeleleni, kodwa apho iigrafu ezimbini zisondele kakhulu kunzima ukwahlula ngeliso, kwaye ayichazi isizathu.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.explain: Kwi-x=5, 2⁵=32>25, kwaye xa x inyuka nge-1, 2ˣ iphindwa kabini ngoxa x² iba (x+1)²/x² amaxesha, angaphantsi kuno-2 xa x≥3. Ngoko xa nje iphambili, umsantsa uqhubeka uphakama. Ukukhangela amaxabiso athile, uhlobo lomsebenzi, okanye imilo yegrafu kuyodwa akuchazi ‘yonke x’.

x-m-h2-03.title: Ngaba sinθ=3/5 yodwa inokusixelela tanθ?
x-m-h2-03.goal: Zifumanele wena imeko apho ulwazi olunikiweyo alumiseli ixabiso elinye, uze ukhethe ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela ixabiso.
x-m-h2-03.material: UJihu wathi kuphela ‘sinθ=3/5 kwi-engile θ’ waza wabuza ixabiso le-tanθ. UDaeun wathi, ‘Alonelanga ulwazi,’ yaye uHyunwoo wathi, ‘Lwanele.’ Indlela yokufunda: sinθ yisayini theta, cosθ yikhosayini theta, tanθ yithanjenti theta, kwaye 3/5 zintathu kwezihlanu.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.prompt: Xa kukho i-engile θ ene-sinθ=3/5, fumana izibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezinokwenzeka zamaxabiso (cosθ, tanθ). (Faka cosθ=c no-tanθ=t; ungabhala amadesimali. umz. 3/5=0.6)
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Faka sinθ=0.6 kwi-sin²θ+cos²θ=1 ubhale ukuba ulingano lwe-cosθ luba yintoni.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba mangaphi amaxabiso e-cosθ anelisa olo lingano, uze ubale tanθ=sinθ÷cosθ kwelinye ngalinye.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.fail.c1: Alenzi sin²θ+cos²θ=1. Khangela ukuba isikwere se-cosθ kufuneka sibe yintoni xa sinθ=0.6.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba sinθ=3/5, ngoko cos²θ=16/25, ngoko cosθ=4/5 okanye −4/5. Ukuba cosθ=0.8, tanθ=0.75, yaye ukuba cosθ=−0.8, tanθ=−0.75, ngoko zimbini iimeko ezinokwenzeka.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba kunikwa nolunye lolu lwazi lulandelayo ukongeza kwi-sinθ=3/5, ixabiso le-tanθ limiselwa libe linye. Khetha lonke olo lwazi.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba ngaba iimeko ezimbini ozifumeneyo kwinyathelo elidlulileyo ziyanelisa imeko kukhetho ngalunye.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Wahlula iinketho apho zombini iimeko ziyanelisa imeko kwezo apho imeko e-1 kuphela eseleyo.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.a: I-engile epozithivu inokuba nakweyiphi ikhwadranti. Hlola ukuba zombini iimeko ozenzileyo ngaphambili ziyasala.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.b: Le meko ishiya imeko e-1 kuphela kwezimbini. Jonga uphawu lwe-cosθ kwikhwadranti yesibini.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.c: θ yi-engile kwikhwadranti yokuqala okanye yesibini
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba sinθ=3/5>0, sele uyazi oku, ngoko akulwazi olutsha. Zombini iimeko ziyasala.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.d: Ukuba sinθ>0 kwaye tanθ<0, uphawu lwe-cosθ lumisiwe. Hlola ukuba yeyiphi kwezimbini zangaphambili eseleyo.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.e: Olu luhlu lubandakanya zombini ikhwadranti yokuqala neyesibini, ngoko zombini iimeko ziyasala.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.f: Ikuxelela uphawu lwe-cosθ ngqo, ngoko imeko e-1 kuphela kwezimbini eseleyo.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.explain: Ukuba sinθ=3/5, ngoko cosθ=±4/5, ngoko ukuba uyazi uphawu lwe-cosθ, tanθ imisiwe. Ikhwadranti yesibini, tanθ<0 (cosθ<0 kuba sinθ>0), kunye ne-cosθ<0 zonke zithetha cosθ<0, ngoko tanθ=−3/4 imisiwe. Kwezinye, imeko cosθ>0 iyasala, ngoko zikho amaxabiso amabini e-tanθ.
